description: Performance review writer — Turns manager notes, accomplishments or peer feedback into a fair, evidence-based performance review: summary, strengths and growth areas each tied to an exact quote from the notes (quotes verified offline), accomplishments, measurable goals for next period and a suggested rating. Offline checks flag biased or coded wording (abrasive, emotional, culture fit...), vague praise and unverified evidence, with a readiness verdict READY / EDIT / REWRITE and a markdown draft. notes= required; optional name=, role=, period=, tone=. Price: $0.008 USDC (Base, via x402).

notes.description: e.g. Dana shipped the new billing system two weeks early, cut invoice errors by 30% and mentored two new engineers. Documentation was often missing and status updates came late.

name: ai_performance_review
